tests.title: Inventory quantities reflect selected warehouse and product variants
tests.goal: A CRM user can inspect available stock by warehouse and variant.
preconditions: At least one active product with variants is available in staging inventory.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and open Inventory.
Select a warehouse and locate a product with variants.
Choose View by: Variants and review the available, stock, and pre-order quantities.

expected.text: The inventory view identifies the selected warehouse and product variants.
Each variant displays its own quantities for the selected warehouse.
Changing the warehouse changes the warehouse context without altering stock.

checks.label: The inventory view identifies the selected warehouse and product variants.
Each variant displays its own quantities for the selected warehouse.
Changing the warehouse changes the warehouse context without altering stock.

notes: View by Variants for test product EN 1: per-variant Available/Stock/Pre-order and per-warehouse columns; variant sums reconcile to the product row (avail 77, stock 84). Selecting TaiPo Warehouse (warehouse_id=12) switches Available/Stock/Pre-order to TaiPo (large-blue 35/39) without changing stock. Negative per-warehouse available values exist in data (e.g. large-red TaiPo -1; BUG-007 family).

tests.title: Transfer receipt moves stock between warehouses
tests.goal: A transfer order records a controlled movement of stock from a source warehouse to a destination warehouse.
preconditions: Two active staging warehouses and a product with sufficient source stock are available.
data: Product, source, destination, and a small controlled quantity selected dynamically.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and record the available quantity of a suitable product at two active warehouses.
Create a uniquely identified transfer order for a small quantity from the source warehouse to the destination warehouse.
Move the order through dispatch/in-transit and receive the transferred quantity at the destination.
Review the transfer record and both warehouse inventory views.

expected.text: The transfer progresses through the applicable Pending, In-transit, and Received states.
The received quantity is reflected at the destination and the source/destination stock totals reconcile to the transfer.
The transfer number and receive time are visible in the record.

checks.label: The transfer progresses through the applicable Pending, In-transit, and Received states.
The received quantity is reflected at the destination and the source/destination stock totals reconcile to the transfer.
The transfer number and receive time are visible in the record.

notes: QA-TO-mvqhvu1l (id 308) Office -> TaiPo, product test 2 x2. Same From/To rejected ("From warehouse and to warehouse cannot be the same."). Create: Pending, Office available 48 -> 46. Transfer > OK: In-transit 17:41:48, Office stock 46. Receive with row toggled: Received 17:42:39, TaiPo 7/6 -> 9/8. Inventory History: PENDING_TRANSFER -2, IN_TRANSIT -2, TRANSFERRED -2, TRANSFER_RECEIVED +2 linked to the transfer. Receive without toggling does nothing (BUG-019, SCRM-094).

tests.title: Approved replenishment request creates a linked transfer
tests.goal: Approving a replenishment request creates a traceable transfer order for the requested stock.
preconditions: Two active warehouses and a product eligible for replenishment are available in staging.
data: Product, warehouses, and a small controlled quantity selected dynamically.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and open Inventory > Replenishment Request.
Create a unique replenishment request for a suitable product, source warehouse, destination warehouse, and small quantity.
Open the request and its linked transfer order.

expected.text: A linked transfer order number is shown and its source, destination, product, and quantity match the request.

checks.label: A linked transfer order number is shown and its source, destination, product, and quantity match the request.

notes: QA-RR-mvqi08o1 (id 155) Office -> TaiPo, product test 2 x1. Approve and Create Transfer Order -> prefilled transfer form -> Submit > Confirm: request Approved, linked Transfer26102709445029e9 (id 310) Pending with same warehouses/product/qty. Shipped and received it: request shows Transfer order status Received; TaiPo 10/9. Qty 999 vs 45 available reached Confirm with no warning (BUG-007 note, not submitted). Detail times in UTC (BUG-006).

tests.title: Reject a payment-review order and verify rejection history
tests.goal: Rejecting a QA payment-review order records the rejection outcome and any supplied reason.
preconditions: A dedicated staging QA order is in Payment review and uses a non-routable QA contact.
data: Existing QA order selected dynamically by status.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM.
Open the QA order in Payment review.
Reject the payment review and enter the QA reason if the form requests one.
Reopen the order and review its status history.

expected.text: The order shows Payment rejected or the corresponding rejection state.
The status history records the rejection and the entered reason when supported.

checks.label: The order shows Payment rejected or the corresponding rejection state.
The status history records the rejection and the entered reason when supported.

notes: Guest order TXN0126102700016 (Bank Transfer, HKD 0.10) with uploaded receipt in Payment review. Receipt tab > comment > Deny > OK: Order Status Payment Rejected, Payment Status Pending payment; Status History "Rejected" by ghani 17:50 with the comment. Guest Order Tracking shows REJECTED and the comment, receipts can be replaced.

tests.title: Receiving a transfer with no product toggled tells staff to select items
tests.goal: Receive on an in-transit transfer gives feedback when no product row is marked as received.
preconditions: An own QA transfer order in In-transit status
data: Transfer created at runtime (small qty between two warehouses)

steps.text: Leave every Received All / row toggle off and click Receive

expected.text: A message says to select at least one product (or Receive is disabled)
Status stays In-transit and no stock moves

checks.label: A message says to select at least one product (or Receive is disabled)
Status stays In-transit and no stock moves

notes: Receive > OK with no row toggled: POST /inventory/transfer-receive 200, no message, still In-transit (twice).
